name: Tree Services
tagline: Tree removal, pruning, stump grinding, arborist
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional tree service. Ask about the tree species, height, location, and access. Ask whether power lines are nearby and whether a permit is required. Ask about stump grinding and green waste removal. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Yes, we hold [licence type] licence [licence number] and [insurer] insurance. Our arborists hold [qualification].

kb.q: Do you offer emergency tree services?
kb.a: {emergency_note} We attend fallen trees and storm damage where it is safe to do so.

kb.q: How much does tree removal cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Tree removal is priced by height, species and access. We quote after an on-site inspection.
Yes, we grind stumps. Roots may need separate work, which we quote separately.
Yes, we prune trees for health, shape and safety. Tell us what you want to achieve so we can recommend the right cut.
Yes, we remove palm trees and fronds. Tell us the palm's height and location when you enquire.
Yes, we provide arborist reports for councils, insurers and owners. The report fee is listed on your quote.
Yes, we chip and remove green waste. Green waste is priced per cubic metre, as listed on your quote.

kb.q: Do I need a council permit?
kb.a: Some trees need a council permit before they are removed or pruned. We can advise you on your local rules before we start.

kb.q: Do you work near power lines?
kb.a: We work near power lines only where the utility has isolated the line, as required. Tell us about any overhead lines at the site before booking.
Yes, we clear land for building or landscaping. Permits may be required, so please check with your council first.
Yes, we trim and shape hedges. Hedge trimming is priced per metre, as listed on your quote.
Yes, we remove surface roots. Deep roots may need excavation, which we quote separately.

kb.q: Can you leave the mulch on site?
kb.a: Yes, we can leave mulch on site or take it away. Tell us which you prefer when you book.

kb.q: How long does a removal take?
kb.a: Most removals take [number] hours, depending on the tree's size and access. We confirm the timing when we quote.
{warranty_note} Ask us what is covered before you book.
We service [your service area]. Ask us to confirm your suburb before booking.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: It helps for the quote. For the work, we need access to the site and to the tree.

kb.q: Do you clean up after the job?
kb.a: Yes, we clean up and remove debris after the job. We confirm what clean-up is included in your quote.
We can advise on tree diseases and treat some conditions. Send us photos of the tree so we can tell you what we can do.

compliance.guidance: Tree removal and pruning near powerlines need energy distributor approval. Some councils require permits for removing protected trees. Check your council and insurance requirements.
